build_coordination: Kyoto unavailable in this Linux workspace; direct serial isolated A/A control builds.

protocol.allocation: Linux-only separate ALLOCATION_METER binary with explicit LD_PRELOAD; not live memory
protocol.memory: Allocator deltas while keys are held and after release; not player RSS or GPU memory
protocol.ordering: AB for even pairs, BA for odd pairs; fresh process for every observation
protocol.scope: Exact ASS semantic-key source plus synthetic corpus; excludes libass, rendering and playback
protocol.tests: Exact production helper and XCTest source in a dependency-free temporary package
protocol.timing: Optimized plain binary; allocation interposer absent

baseline.transformation: Extract the unique original nested ProcessedPacketKey fields; remove private and outer type nesting; rename to ProcessedSubtitlePacketKey. Extract its exact firstIndex/map normalization expression, rename its input data to packetData, and wrap it in an initializer with unchanged millisecond fields. No payload policy is changed.

candidate.transformation: Extract the unique original nested ProcessedPacketKey fields; remove private and outer type nesting; rename to ProcessedSubtitlePacketKey. Extract its exact firstIndex/map normalization expression, rename its input data to packetData, and wrap it in an initializer with unchanged millisecond fields. No payload policy is changed.

tests.reason: A/A uses baseline in both slots; candidate ownership tests intentionally do not apply
